text:
- ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW generated £4.6k revenue TW, the highest performing product by revenue this week.
- Total revenue reached £25.6k TW, representing a 56.2% WoW increase from £16.4k LW.
- CAMOFLAGE DESIGN TEDDY surged 6340.5% WoW in revenue, the strongest growth rate among all products.
- PACK OF 72 RETRO SPOT CAKE CASES led unit sales with 1724 units TW, followed by WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at 909 units TW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER generated £2.4k revenue TW across 43 orders, the highest order count for any product.
- PINK HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUNTING and BLUE HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUNTING both declined 61.5% and 59.4% WoW respectively in revenue.
- Total units sold reached 8388 TW, with MAGNETS PACK OF 4 VINTAGE COLLAGE achieving 4954.6% WoW revenue growth despite lower absolute sales.
- RED RETROSPOT CAKE STAND generated £1.5k revenue TW with 1269.8% WoW growth, demonstrating strong momentum week over week.
